family.triumph-adler-ta20.description: Office computers, data-entry systems and terminals for data centres.
family.triumph-adler-ta20.history: Triumph-Adler organised the TA 20 range in three branches. TA 20 models handled office work. The TA 21 and DATEV DES captured data for later processing. The TA 22 combined data entry with local processing and data exchange with other systems.
